meta_data.base_class: Provide real-time data and map integration for nearby <public service points> - refers to various public facilities whose locations and availability can be searched.

tool_template.name: get_<class>_information
tool_template.description: Provides real-time data and map integration for nearby <class> locations.

time.description: Time of the day to check for <class> availability.

mapProvider.description: The map provider for integrating <class> data into maps and used for displaying locations.

icon.description: Icon to represent <class> on the map.

color.description: Color code for the <class> markers on the map, with the pattern '^#([A-Fa-f0-9]{6}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{3})$'.

availabilityStatus.description: Current availability status of the <class> that would be filtered, one of: 'open', 'closed', 'under maintenance'.

minimumRating.description: Minimum average rating (0 to 5) for the <class> to be included.

facilityFeatures.description: Specific features to filter by, e.g., 'wheelchair accessible', '24/7'.
